verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS finance platform that ingests ledger, payroll and bank data. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion requests, or account or data purge. Related features such as undoable writes, stopping a sync, and removing synced tables are adjacent controls, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
